goal: Is ke baad aap if-else-if ladder use karke kai results mein se ek result choose kar sakenge, aur samjha sakenge ke conditions ka order kyun matter karta hai.
warmup: Teacher aap ke marks dekh kar grade deti hain. Woh har grade check nahi karti. Woh upar se shuru karti hain: 'Kya 85 ya zyada hain? Nahi. 70 ya zyada? Haan, to B hai.' Woh wahin ruk jati hain. Woh C ya D check karne aage nahi jati. Rickshaw wala bhi fare slabs ke saath yahi karta hai: 2 km tak Rs 100, 5 km tak Rs 150, aur aise hi aage. Aap upar se check karte hain aur pehle 'haan' par ruk jate hain.
definition: If-else-if ladder conditions ki ek chain hai jo upar se neeche check hoti hai. Computer PEHLI true condition ka block run karta hai aur baaki sab skip kar deta hai. Aakhri else optional hai. Yeh tab chalta hai jab koi bhi condition true na ho. Ladder tab use karein jab do se zyada possible results hon aur woh ek doosre ko exclude karte hon (ek mark sirf ek hi grade ka ho sakta hai).
howItWorks: Flowchart par Play dabayein ya slider hilayein. Computer pehli condition test karta hai. Agar woh false ho, to woh neeche agli condition par jata hai. Jaise hi koi condition true hoti hai, us ka block run hota hai aur computer poori ladder ke baad jump kar jata hai. Order matter karta hai: kyunke pehli true condition jeet jati hai, isliye sab se strict test sab se pehle likhein. Agar aap marks >= 85 se pehle marks >= 50 test karein, to 90 marks wala student pehle hi test par ruk jayega aur ghalat grade le ga. Yeh bhi dekhein ke baad ke tests mein '&& marks < 85' likhne ki zaroorat nahi. Agar marks 85 ya zyada hote, to pehle wala test pehle hi jeet chuka hota.
